format: Warm paper with subtle creative grid, animated Inter text and drawn diagrams on one continuous page
diagram_rules: Never route connector lines or arrowheads through, behind or across text, boxes or unrelated objects.
End connectors outside their target border with visible clearance (24px minimum at 1080px wide); keep arrowheads fully visible.
Use distinct connection ports; avoid connector crossings.
Hide old connectors before moving nodes; redraw only after nodes settle. Check transitions as well as resting frames.
If a route is crowded, reposition nodes or simplify the diagram; never hide the problem with layering.

drawing_style.geometry: Precise circles and rectangles for structural nodes; subtle human variation reserved for arrows and annotation strokes.
drawing_style.shapes: Geometrically regular, unfilled outlines with consistent stroke weight; simple entrance, no hand wobble.
drawing_style.arrows: Separate shaft and head; align head to terminal tangent; short straight approach; asymmetric wing length allowed; both wings remain on opposite sides of shaft; never cross shaft except at tip
drawing_style.review: Inspect arrowheads at full resolution, phone size, during reveal and after nodes move; automated layout passing is insufficient

grid.texture: uniform micro grid with no emphasized subdivisions

font_experiment.usage: short handwritten annotations only; Inter remains the main typeface

status: reusable diagram format; prototype in work/paper-grid
audio: diagrams are cutaways synchronised to the creator's real narration; never a synthesized voice
